# BCGov Raven - v0.2.0

## Release type

Pre-stable minor release: reliability fixes, a new read-only Sonar tool, setup
improvements, and dependency security updates.

## Summary

Browser login for SiteMinder- and SharePoint-backed servers no longer needs a
manual reset after a session expires, the credential setup scripts now ship in
every bundle, and four dependency advisories are resolved.

## Highlights

### Authentication (`raven-auth`)

- A dead SiteMinder session (`SMSESSION=LOGGEDOFF`) is no longer cached as
  valid. Captured cookies are verified against the protected page before use.
- Concurrent MCP servers share one login: a lock serialises browser captures,
  and a failed login is not retried by every waiting server.
- Optional autofill of the login form and a `--force` flag to re-authenticate
  even when a cached session exists.
- Jenkins on a SiteMinder-protected host falls back to the browser session when
  Basic authentication is redirected to the login page.

### Sonar MCP

- New read-only `sonar_list_projects` tool lists the SonarQube projects the
  configured user token can browse, with their keys and names. It does not
  require administrator permissions.
- Scans locate `sonar-scanner` (or `sonar-scanner.bat` on Windows) on `PATH`
  when `SONAR_SCANNER_BIN` is not set.

### Credential setup

- `scripts/setup-credentials.ps1` (Windows) and
  `scripts/setup-credentials-mac.mjs` (macOS) are included in the platform
  bundles.
- Type `:clear` at any prompt to erase a stored value.
- Atlassian credentials are optional.

## Security updates

| Package | Severity | Advisory |
|---|---|---|
| proxy-addr 2.0.8 | Critical | CVE-2026-90711 |
| source-map-js 1.2.2 | High | CVE-2026-93749 |
| fast-uri 3.1.8 | Medium | CVE-2026-86472 |
| ip-address 10.7.2 | Medium | CVE-2026-101910 |

Grouped minor and patch dependency updates and GitHub Actions updates are also
included.

## Installation and verification

Download the archive and matching manifest for the target platform. Confirm the
archive digest against the manifest, then verify publisher provenance:

```text
gh attestation verify <archive> --repo bcgov/raven
```

Extract the archive and configure the desired launchers from its `bin`
directory. Credentials remain in Raven's documented user-local credential
store and are not part of the archive.

## Support

This is a pre-stable `0.x` release. Launcher, catalog, update, rollback, and
platform support contracts may evolve before `1.0.0`.
